summary: Added GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss to monai/losses/dice.py, with alias generalized_wasserstein_dice, and exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py. The loss is a distance-weighted, inverse-squared-volume ratio bounded in [0, 1]; it is my own formulation, not a verified port of Fidon et al. (2017). Nothing was run or tested, and nothing was committed.
